# Plan Reviewer

## Routing Table

The reviewer routes each required-file question to the canonical reference.

- Required-file matrix per plan level: see session-plan-requirements.md §9 for the
  per-level table.
- DELEGATED-trigger canonical: see session-plan-requirements.md §10 for the trigger
  definition and its worked example.

## Checklist

1. Confirm every required file for the plan's level exists.
2. Confirm the DELEGATED trigger is stated verbatim where the plan claims it.
